notes: Exact computed role matching; missing and multiple matches retry until the deadline with typed ExpectationFailed evidence, while Playwright rejects multiple matches immediately. Plain div/span elements retain the shared HTML-AAM generic role; Playwright reports no role. ARIA presentation conflict exceptions also apply to inherited roles on the child, and required-child inheritance stops when parent presentation is cancelled; the pinned Playwright ancestor walk can retain presentation in those cases. Table captions inherit presentation as required by ARIA. Tabindex conflicts use HTML integer parsing: leading ASCII whitespace, optional sign and digits, ignoring trailing text. Thus 2abc counts as focusable and leading non-ASCII whitespace does not; pinned Playwright uses JavaScript number conversion and differs.

decision.quote: Role assertions, role locators, and snapshots use one DOM role computation, retaining HTML-AAM `generic` roles for plain elements such as `div`.
